message: The other night, we had a surprise power outage, and my friend Sarah instantly went into panic mode. I swear, she was ready to start a search party for her phone charger as if it were lost at sea! Meanwhile, I just pulled out my trusty flashlight and power bank, and we ended up playing card games by lantern light. It was such a fun reminder that a little prep can turn a blackout into a cozy night in. Ever had a similar experience with a friend who's all about the drama?
